retell: A finance person is about to send board files at 8:57 and the deck doesn't match the model.
Earlier she had asked a chatbot to update the memo, and every time it said 'Done' the file was broken, the deck kept the old number and regenerating took minutes.
Agentic Office takes one request, finds the number in the model, memo and deck, and shows each change as a tracked edit she can accept, including the slide 4 that slipped.
She sends the files with every change reviewed, the sun comes up, and you can request early access.

issues.evidence: Between the reveal and the payoff the film detours into templates (54 s), a conference-room photo with 'Something new? Every new element is marked.' (55-58 s), the Room with a simulated teammate (95-101 s) and local storage (102-106 s); none of these touches the €74.6m problem.
issues.suggested_action: Cut or compress templates and the new-element shot to under 2 s total, and make the Room beat use the same €74.6m proposal (it already does at 99 s) so every block serves the one number.

issues.evidence: After 'All changes reviewed 10 of 10' (f_36), the Room shot (f_39, f_41) shows the memo sentence and table back at '€71–73m' and Priya's Assistant again proposing 'Replace €71–73m with €74.6m'.
issues.suggested_action: Either place the Room beat before the Accept-all, or label it as a separate scenario; otherwise the viewer reads that the accepted fix was lost.

issues.evidence: Three 'Done.' cycles plus a Copy/Paste montage run 41 s before the logo; the third cycle (30-37 s) repeats the second's lesson.
issues.suggested_action: Merge Done #2 and #3 into one beat (deck regenerated, slide 2 fixed, slide 4 reverted) and save ~6-8 s.

issues.evidence: The protagonist last appears at ~44.5 s (head on desk); the 'Sent' payoff (f_43-f_44) is a different candle-lit room with no person, then an empty sunrise.
issues.suggested_action: Close on the same woman in the same office at the Send click and a beat of relief, so the person whose problem we followed gets the payoff.

issues.evidence: Memo tracked change shows '€71–73m → €74.6m' in the sentence, but Table 1 in the same frame still reads 'FY26 outlook €71–73m'.
issues.suggested_action: Show the table cell change too (it is in the change list at 87 s as the third memo edit) or frame tighter on the sentence.

issues.evidence: The final email shows a single 'Board_Memo_Q3.docx' chip while the toast says 'Memo · model · deck'; the opening email had three attachments.
issues.suggested_action: Render all three attachment chips in the payoff email to rhyme with frame 1.

issues.evidence: End card 'Request early access' with no URL or where-to-go.
issues.suggested_action: Add the URL under the button.

top_revision: Cut the off-story feature beats (templates, new-element photo) and move the Room beat before Accept-all so the post-reveal act is one unbroken chain: one request → every file touched → slide 4 caught → all accepted → sent.
